chapter: Recent years and early piano influences
title: Alex Hill and "Long About Midnight" with Willie Bryant
summary: He met Hill with Bryant in Philadelphia in 1935; the song was Willie's Apollo feature.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Well, Alex Hill was in that category, you know.
Yeah, when I was with Willie Bryant's Orchestra. He did something with Bryant in Philadelphia in 1935.
I think Alex Hill wrote that song "Long About Midnight." Have you heard that one?
Oh, it was the theme song of the... I never saw the music to it. I just played it by ear.
"Long About Midnight." That was Willie's big song at the Apollo Theatre. We were the house band at the Apollo Theatre, you see...
